parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing rigidity and support for other parts.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the base, shelves, door, and drawer, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds all other components together.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing foundational support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is an internal horizontal board made of MDF, used for organizing stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space of the cabinet and supports stored objects.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but can sometimes be adjustable or removable.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel that covers the front opening of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and protects contents from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment made of solid wood, located at the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides accessible storage for smaller items and is frequently used.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails or runners for access.
